# Bliss Digital

> Digital marketing agency in South Jakarta, Indonesia (PT Blissindo Kreasi
> Digital). We run Google Ads, Meta Ads, websites and social media for
> businesses, so they can focus on running the business. Google Partner.

Our promise: reach the right people, at the right time, with the right
message. We agree on one goal before any spend, check tracking first, report
results in plain words, and clients keep ownership of their ad accounts.

The site is available in English (/en) and Bahasa Indonesia (/id).

## Services

- [Google Ads](https://blissdigital.id/en/services#google-ads): fully managed
  campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Display, Demand Gen, YouTube, Local), or
  a consultation with a written action plan, or training for teams.
- [Meta Ads](https://blissdigital.id/en/services#meta-ads): fully managed
  Facebook and Instagram ads, including lead ads, WhatsApp chat ads and
  retargeting.
- [Website creation](https://blissdigital.id/en/services#website): websites
  built to be found on Google (SEO) and in AI answers (GEO), with tracking set
  up at launch.
- [Social media management](https://blissdigital.id/en/services#social-media):
  Instagram and TikTok content planning, copywriting, design, posting and
  monthly reports.
